verdict.rationale: Railway's marketing docs claim 'Run your application closer to where your users are' (railway-docs-7), implying region selection, but there is no concrete evidence of a region-picker UI, list of supported regions, or per-service region configuration in the pack. Community reports (railway-comm-4, railway-comm-6) suggest heavy reliance on a single GCP backend and a platform-wide outage, undermining confidence in robust multi-region deployment.
